# Frostner

Internal ID: MaceSilver | Type: Club | Source: Forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Silver x45 | Attack speed: 1.72 s | Chain last hit: 2x damage, +20% knockback | Hitbox: 2.5 range, 30 angle, 0.8 height, 0.3 ray, vertical | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Frostner is the fourth one-handed club. Its primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. Its slower secondary attack deals 2.5x damage and 2x staggering.
Its very high knockback and slow makes it a good choice for fighting multiple foes at once. These attributes in combination with different damage types make the Frostner a very effective all round weapon even in later biomes.

## Notes

• The Frost damage is applied instantly, even though the slow persists over time.
• The Spirit damage is applied over time (and only affects some enemies).
• The hammer itself also gives off a Frost Aura, which is a purely visual effect.
• The Wet status causes Frost weakness, making the Frostner effective against enemies submerged in water (rain only affects players).
• Players are less likely to see a foe stagger from damage from Frostner compared to other maces; this is because frost does not contribute to staggering, only physical damage does.
• The knockback can be detrimental when focusing a target down, especially when playing in a group. Using the secondary attack to finish off the target may be preferred over primary attacks.
• The combination of knockback and slowing effect provided by frost makes the Frostner optimal for crowd control.

## Trivia

• Frostner's appearance is loosely based on archeological finds and artistic representations of Mjölnir, the one-handed hammer of Thor.
